description: Update one item in a collection: set or clear its note, record the person's own edits to the track in modifications (exported credits list them), or move it to a new position. Use it to annotate or move one item. Not for the whole order or for removing the item; use reorder_collection or remove_from_collection for those. Returns the updated collection. Needs a signed-in account; fields left out are unchanged; fails with stale_revision when revision is out of date. Example: {"collection_id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f","track_id":"ic-ccab784f22","note":"fade out at 0:20"}.

collection_id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

modifications.description: The person's own changes to the track, never inferred: chips ("trimmed", "loudness adjusted", "looped", "edited") and text. Replaces the recorded modifications.

text.description: The person's own words for the change, up to 200 characters, such as "cut to 15 seconds".

note.description: Note up to 500 characters, such as "fade out at 0:20"; an empty string clears it.

position.description: Zero-based place in the track order to move the item to; 0 is first.

revision.description: The collection's current revision, returned by get_collection or list_collections; when given, the change fails with stale_revision if the collection was edited since.

track_id.description: The id of a track in the collection, as returned by get_collection.

name: update_collection_item

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Update a collection item
